message: Last week, I was in the kitchen trying to whip up dinner when the smoke alarm decided to join the fun—turns out it was just a little too much garlic in the pan! 🧄😅 Amidst the chaos, our family group chat lit up with jokes about my 'smoky gourmet' skills and reminders to check our escape plan. It was a perfect reminder that while kitchen mishaps happen, having a plan in place makes everything feel a little more manageable. Have you chatted with your family about your escape routes lately?
